name: Where an exhibit sits relative to its section

values.gloss: the reader sees it before the section's text (the shape first)
a sidebar or margin element read with the text
collapsed under a titled line after its section and opened on a click (a reference exhibit the reader consults, never the page's lead)

note: The text is the main dish (the owner, 2026-09-07 11:45): only verdict chips may stand before the first section; a wide exhibit (timeline, table, map) is folded or after, never floated and never the lead.
